dialogue_texts: Our biggest goal now is to find Fusana.
When you were fighting off the glohm for the first time, she was a maid.
Now that night has fallen, she's a princess.
I've seen both forms. She has even shown her transformation to me.
I want to dance with her right away...
We can put on a ball after you deal with the glohm and its perpetrator.
I want to see my beloved right away, but I don't want her to infect me.
I will leave it up to you. I will hide in a place where the glohm won't see me.
Allow me to sleep in peace. I'll only wake up if my partner... gives me a kiss.
You'll infect your partner that way.
Let me take care of removing the glohm for you.
